messages:
customer-alex: Hey team — running into a weird CORS + auth issue when using the TypeScript SDK in Bun on Vercel Edge. Browser shows a 401 on the POST after preflight even though the same request from Node works.
Morgan (support): Thanks for the report — can you paste minimal repro? Which SDK version and which auth flow? :eyes:
customer-alex: SDK @ 0.9.3-edge, using apiKey in `Authorization: Bearer ...`. Repro snippet (client code in edge function):
```js
// edge function handler
await fetch('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_KEY}`
  },
  credentials: 'include',
  body: JSON.stringify({prompt: 'hi'})
})
```
customer-alex: Preflight returns 204 OK, then the actual POST gets 401 with response body from our proxy: `{"error":"unauthenticated"}`. If I remove `credentials: 'include'` it works in Chrome but fails in Safari (opaque redirect).
Sahil (eng): Interesting — Bun's fetch behavior + Vercel adapter might reorder headers or include `cookie`/credentials differently. Do you see `authorization` in the network tab for the POST?
customer-alex: Chrome: header present. Safari: POST shows no Authorization header (only preflight had it). Server logs show missing header. Server sees an `OPTIONS` with auth but not the POST.
Jamie (devex): Can you confirm redirect chain? Sometimes fetch with `credentials: 'include'` + a cross-origin redirect causes browsers to drop Authorization on redirect. Any 302/307 in between?
customer-alex: We have an internal CDN that 302 -> regional edge. Logs show a 307 from cdn.example -> api.redwood.example. Seems like on redirect the header is dropped. But why only in Safari and only when `credentials: 'include'` in Bun edge?
Morgan (support): Repro plan: 1) try `redirect: 'manual'` to see the redirect and confirm Authorization drop. 2) try `credentials: 'omit'` and test. 3) try server-side request from Node 18 to confirm this is browser+edge-runtime specific.
support-bot: New support ticket created: #S-21044 linking to thread.
Sahil (eng): Quick note: some edge runtimes (and Bun's fetch polyfill) will add `Cookie`/`Authorization` on preflight or mutate request when credentials set. Combined with 307, some browsers won't forward auth across origins. Workaround: avoid cross-origin 307s, or add a short-lived signed header on the final host, or instruct CDN to use 200+internal-rewrite.
customer-alex: I tried `redirect: 'manual'` and can see the 307. When I issue the final request directly to the origin (skip CDN) it works in Safari. So CDN redirect is the culprit.
Jamie (devex): For a short-term fix: 1) set `credentials: 'omit'` and send API key via query param (not ideal), or 2) configure the CDN to rewrite proxied host without a 307, or 3) use a same-origin edge proxy on your Vercel project to avoid cross-origin redirect. We'll add a KB for this exact combo (Bun + Vercel Edge + CDN 307).
Morgan (support): We'll also escalate to CDN partner if you want us to engage. Do you want support to open a ticket with them? :telephone_receiver:
customer-alex: Please do — we've got users on Safari complaining. Appreciate the quick triage.
Sahil (eng): Logging follow-ups: capture raw headers on both OPTIONS and POST on the CDN and origin. If possible, include full trace id and request ids. We'll check if the SDK's fetch wrapper sets any additional flags in Bun that could interact with credentials.
customer-alex: Thanks — attaching logs to ticket #S-21044. Will try the same-origin proxy workaround and report back. :thumbsup:
